name: Say Hello
description: Two friends are travelling through Bubble galaxy. They say "Hello!" via signals to each other if their distance is smaller or equal than $$$d_1$$$ and it's the first time they speak to each other or at some point in time after their last talk their distance was greater than $$$d_2$$$. We need to calculate how many times friends said "Hello!" to each other. For $$$N$$$ moments, you'll have an array of points for each friend representing their positions at that moment. A person can stay in the same position between two moments in time, but if a person made a move we assume this movement as movement with constant speed in constant direction.
input_specification: The first line contains one integer number $$$N$$$ ($$$2 \leq N \leq 100\,000$$$) representing number of moments in which we captured positions for two friends. The second line contains two integer numbers $$$d_1$$$ and $$$d_2 \ (0 \lt d_1 \lt d_2 \lt 1000)$$$. The next $$$N$$$ lines contains four integer numbers $$$A_x,A_y,B_x,B_y$$$ ($$$0 \leq A_x, A_y, B_x, B_y \leq 1000$$$) representing coordinates of friends A and B in each captured moment.
output_specification: Output contains one integer number that represents how many times friends will say "Hello!" to each other.
subsubtopic: 480. Points, Vectors, Transformations, Dot Products, Cross Products, Precision Issues and Polar Sort(2D)
approach_summary: Apply Points, Vectors, Transformations, Dot Products, Cross Products, Precision Issues and Polar Sort(2D) paradigm under the Geometry framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
